title: 세션 편집

fields.name: Session name
fields.jumpChainHint: Add jump hosts in order. Path: primary → hop 1 → hop 2 → … → final host. If a hop's password is empty, the previous host's ~/.ssh/ key is used automatically.
fields.jumpChainEmpty: No jumps — connect directly to the primary host.
fields.keepAliveEnabled: Send keep alive messages while the session is connected
fields.keepAliveSendString: Send a string when the network is idle
fields.keepAliveTcp: Send TCP keep alive packets when the network is idle
fields.scrollOnOutput: Scroll to the bottom on terminal input/output
fields.scrollOnOutputPauseOnScrollLock: Pause scrolling to the bottom while ScrollLock is on
fields.scrollOnKeyPress: Scroll to the bottom on key press
fields.altScrollShowsScrollback: Scrolling up in full-screen programs (vi, less) shows the previous screen

tooltips.autoTrackInfo: Refresh file tree when changing directory in terminal
tooltips.x11Info: Show remote GUI apps as native Windows windows
tooltips.applyTitle: Save settings and keep window open
tooltips.keepAliveInfo: Keep alive messages work at the SSH protocol level — they keep the TCP/SSH connection up, but the remote shell still sees no input, so they do not prevent the server's TMOUT (shell auto-logout). Use the idle string for that. Leaving the string empty sends a NUL character, which leaves no trace on screen.

advancedHint: Pick a sub-item (file tree / X11 forwarding etc.) from the left tree.

advanced.logPathTooltip: Log file path auto-filled when this session is selected in LogAnalyzer
advanced.codePathTooltip: Base directory auto-filled when this session is selected in the file compare workspace

filetree.disabledHint: Available only when Show file tree is enabled
filetree.autoTrackTooltip: Auto-refresh file tree path on cd in terminal

dbms.useSshTunnelJump: Connect JDBC from the final SSH host of the jump chain
dbms.useSshTunnelNormal: Port-forward over the SSH session, then connect JDBC locally
dbms.driverJarMissing: ❌ Driver JAR missing — add the JAR in Driver Manager
dbms.sshIpcMissing: ❌ SSH tunnel IPC not registered — restart Electron main
dbms.sshFailed: ❌ SSH tunnel failed: {{error}} — connect a terminal for the same session first
dbms.sshTunnelOk: SSH tunnel OK ({{remoteHost}}:{{remotePort}} → local={{localPort}}) — testing JDBC...
dbms.tunnelSectionSub: Leave empty to connect directly without a tunnel.

errors.invalidHost: Enter a valid IPv4/IPv6 or hostname.
